name: still-planned-snapshot-db-side
body: The still-planned snapshot asserts database equality on its own grounds: the node row plus its complete incoming and outgoing edge set, read with relation-type-agnostic patterns so an unasserted family still breaks equality, and compared byte for byte before and after both build paths (a full load and an unrelated-file splice). Limit: the snapshot covers one Module's row and its incident and outgoing edges in `db.lbug`, not whole-graph equality. Upgrade by widening the snapshot scope if the still-planned exclusion must be proven against more than the one ghost node.
